changes.definitionEn: to sit or lie down and relax
changes.definitionUz: O‘tirib yoki yotib dam olmoq.

examples.textEn: It was a Friday evening, and I was absolutely worn out, so all I wanted was to get home and put my feet up.
examples.textUz: Juma oqshomi edi. Men juda charchagandim, shuning uchun faqat uyga borib, oyoqlarimni uzatib dam olishni xohlardim.

changes.definitionEn: to be in a situation with an uncertain outcome
changes.definitionUz: Vaziyatning qanday tugashi noma’lum bo‘lmoq.

examples.textEn: Unlike many office jobs, it involves dealing with unpredictable situations where people's lives can literally hang in the balance.
examples.textUz: Ko‘plab ofis ishlaridan farqli ravishda, bu kasb odamlarning hayoti xavf ostida qolishi mumkin bo‘lgan kutilmagan vaziyatlarni hal qilishni talab etadi.

changes.definitionEn: time spent giving someone undivided attention
changes.definitionUz: Kimdirga butun e’tiborini berib birga o‘tkaziladigan vaqt.

examples.textEn: What made that evening special wasn't the food or the decorations; it was the quality time we spent together.
examples.textUz: O‘sha oqshomni taom yoki bezaklar emas, bir-birimizga e’tibor berib birga o‘tkazgan vaqtimiz o‘zgacha qilgan edi.

changes.definitionEn: the rate or difficulty of learning a new skill
changes.definitionUz: Yangi ko‘nikmani o‘rganish sur’ati yoki qiyinlik darajasi.

examples.textEn: It looks straightforward from the outside, but I know there's a steep learning curve.
examples.textUz: Tashqaridan qaraganda oson tuyuladi, lekin uni o‘rganish anchagina mehnat talab qilishini bilaman.

changes.definitionEn: to help someone because you have been helped by another person
changes.definitionUz: O‘ziga qilingan yaxshilik evaziga boshqa birovga yordam bermoq.

examples.textEn: He simply said that people had supported him when he was younger, and he wanted to pay it forward.
examples.textUz: U yoshligida odamlar unga yordam berganini va endi o‘zi ham boshqalarga yaxshilik qilmoqchi ekanini aytdi, xolos.

changes.definitionEn: to make an already bad situation worse
changes.definitionUz: Allaqachon yomon bo‘lgan vaziyatni yanada og‘irlashtirmoq.

examples.textEn: To make matters worse, it started pouring with rain, and the shelter was far too small for everyone.
examples.textUz: Ustiga-ustak, jala quya boshladi, bekatdagi pana joy esa hammani sig‘dirish uchun juda kichik edi.

changes.definitionEn: to meet or encounter something or someone directly
changes.definitionUz: Kimdir yoki nimagadir bevosita duch kelmoq.

examples.textEn: Nurses regularly come face to face with people who are frightened or in pain, and they can't simply switch off their feelings at the end of the day.
examples.textUz: Hamshiralar qo‘rquv yoki og‘riq ichidagi odamlar bilan muntazam yuzma-yuz keladilar va ish kuni tugagach his-tuyg‘ularini shunchaki o‘chirib qo‘ya olmaydilar.

changes.definitionEn: to seem believable or consistent with experience
changes.definitionUz: Ishonarli yoki hayotiy tajribaga mos tuyulmoq.

examples.textEn: The characters may be exaggerated, but the message still rings true: the way we treat other people matters.
examples.textUz: Qahramonlar biroz bo‘rttirilgan bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin asosiy fikr hayotga mos: boshqalarga qanday munosabatda bo‘lishimiz muhim.

changes.definitionEn: to have a natural ability to notice or judge something
changes.definitionUz: Biror narsani payqash yoki baholashga tabiiy qobiliyati bo‘lmoq.

examples.textEn: Sellers often have an eye for quality, and they can usually tell which melon is ripe just by looking at it and smelling it.
examples.textUz: Sotuvchilar ko‘pincha sifatni yaxshi ajrata oladilar. Odatda ular qovunga qarab va hidlab, uning pishganini bilishadi.

changes.definitionEn: to feel pleased or excited about something in the future
changes.definitionUz: Kelajakdagi biror narsani xursandlik yoki hayajon bilan kutmoq.

examples.textEn: That's probably why people look forward to melon season every year.
examples.textUz: Odamlarning har yili qovun mavsumini intizorlik bilan kutishiga sabab ham shu bo‘lsa kerak.

changes.definitionEn: a temporary interruption in the supply of electricity
changes.definitionUz: Elektr ta’minotining vaqtincha uzilishi.

examples.textEn: The power came back later, but by then nobody really cared.
examples.textUz: Keyinroq elektr qaytdi, lekin o‘sha paytga kelib bu hech kimni unchalik qiziqtirmay qo‘ygandi.

changes.definitionEn: to fail to notice how much time has passed
changes.definitionUz: Qancha vaqt o‘tganini sezmay qolmoq.

examples.textEn: We were so caught up in the conversation that we almost lost track of time.
examples.textUz: Suhbatga shunchalik berilib ketdikki, vaqt qanday o‘tganini deyarli sezmay qoldik.

changes.definitionEn: to do something too much or in an excessive way
changes.definitionUz: Biror ishni haddan tashqari ko‘p qilmoq.

examples.textEn: I added the sauce gradually rather than going overboard, which turned out to be a sensible decision.
examples.textUz: Sousni birdan ko‘p solish o‘rniga oz-ozdan qo‘shdim. Bu oqilona qaror bo‘lib chiqdi.

changes.definitionEn: to become unable to speak or act because of nervousness
changes.definitionUz: Asabiylashish tufayli gapira yoki harakat qila olmay qolmoq.

examples.textEn: He knew plenty of words, but whenever someone asked him a question, he would freeze up.
examples.textUz: U juda ko‘p so‘z bilardi, lekin kimdir savol bersa, hayajondan qotib qolardi.

records.sourceTranslationUz: o‘z fikrini erkin ifoda eta boshlamoq

changes.definitionEn: to develop the confidence to express your opinions
changes.translationUz: o‘z fikrini erkin ifoda eta boshlamoq
changes.definitionUz: O‘z fikrlarini bildirishga ishonch hosil qila boshlamoq.

examples.textEn: More importantly, it gives someone else a chance to find their voice.
examples.textUz: Eng muhimi, bu boshqa bir insonga o‘z fikrini erkin ifoda etishni boshlash imkonini beradi.

changes.definitionEn: to begin to understand or deal with a challenging subject
changes.definitionUz: Murakkab mavzuni tushuna yoki u bilan ishlay boshlamoq.

examples.textEn: For a start, I'd have to get to grips with the basic strokes, especially serving and returning the ball.
examples.textUz: Avvalo, asosiy zarbalarni, ayniqsa to‘pni o‘yinga kiritish va qaytarishni puxta o‘zlashtirishim kerak bo‘lardi.

changes.definitionEn: a collection of supplies kept ready for an emergency
changes.definitionUz: Favqulodda vaziyat uchun oldindan tayyorlab qo‘yilgan zarur buyumlar to‘plami.

examples.textEn: Buildings need to meet safety standards, and families should know where to take shelter and how to put together an emergency kit.
examples.textUz: Binolar xavfsizlik talablariga javob berishi, oilalar esa qayerdan pana topish va favqulodda vaziyat to‘plamini qanday tayyorlashni bilishlari kerak.

changes.definitionEn: to watch for or take care of someone or something
changes.definitionUz: Kimdir yoki nimanidir ehtiyot bo‘lib kuzatmoq yoxud unga g‘amxo‘rlik qilmoq.

examples.textEn: We can't prevent earthquakes, but we can reduce the risks and look out for one another afterwards.
examples.textUz: Zilzilalarni to‘xtata olmaymiz, lekin xavflarni kamaytirishimiz va ulardan keyin bir-birimizga g‘amxo‘rlik qilishimiz mumkin.

changes.definitionEn: an effect on someone's opinion or memory that continues
changes.definitionUz: Birovning fikri yoki xotirasida uzoq saqlanadigan ta’sir.

examples.textEn: It also reminded me that the best presents aren't necessarily expensive; they're the ones that leave a lasting impression.
examples.textUz: Bu menga eng yaxshi sovg‘alar albatta qimmat bo‘lishi shart emasligini, muhimi ular uzoq esda qoladigan taassurot qoldirishini ham eslatdi.

changes.definitionEn: occasionally rather than regularly
changes.definitionUz: Muntazam emas, ba’zan sodir bo‘lish.

examples.textEn: A mobile game I play from time to time is online chess.
examples.textUz: Telefonimda vaqti-vaqti bilan o‘ynaydigan o‘yinim onlayn shaxmat.

changes.definitionEn: without doing or using something excessively
changes.definitionUz: Biror ishni haddan oshirmasdan qilish yoki narsani me’yorida ishlatish.

examples.textEn: I try to keep the game in moderation.
examples.textUz: O‘yinni me’yorida o‘ynashga harakat qilaman.

changes.definitionEn: gases released from the exhaust of a vehicle
changes.definitionUz: Transport vositasining chiqarish quvuridan chiqadigan gazlar.

examples.textEn: On some days, the air seems hazy, and it's hard not to notice the smell of exhaust fumes near busy roads.
examples.textUz: Ba’zi kunlari havo xira ko‘rinadi, serqatnov yo‘llar yonida esa avtomobil chiqindi gazlarining hidini sezmaslik qiyin.

changes.definitionEn: the degree to which the air is clean or polluted
changes.definitionUz: Havoning qanchalik toza yoki ifloslanganligi.

examples.textEn: The result is poor air quality, which is especially worrying for children, older people and anyone with breathing problems.
examples.textUz: Natijada havo sifati yomonlashadi. Bu, ayniqsa, bolalar, keksalar va nafas olishida muammosi bor kishilar uchun tashvishli.

changes.definitionEn: a rapid solution that may not solve the underlying cause
changes.definitionUz: Muammoning asl sababini bartaraf etmasligi mumkin bo‘lgan tezkor yechim.

examples.textEn: In my view, the key is to take a long-term approach rather than relying on quick fixes.
examples.textUz: Menimcha, asosiysi tezkor yechimlarga tayanishdan ko‘ra uzoq muddatni ko‘zlab ish tutishdir.

changes.definitionEn: the fundamental cause of a problem
changes.definitionUz: Muammoning kelib chiqishidagi asosiy sabab.

examples.textEn: For example, if I get stuck on a technical issue, I tend to experiment with different approaches until I find the root cause.
examples.textUz: Masalan, texnik muammoga duch kelsam, uning asl sababini topmagunimcha turli usullarni sinab ko‘rishga moyilman.

records.replacedIrrelevantSourceExample: A few friends and I had been looking forward to it for weeks because it was supposed to feature live music, food stalls and traditional performances.

changes.definitionEn: the overall situation instead of the small details
changes.definitionUz: Mayda tafsilotlardan ko‘ra vaziyatning umumiy ko‘rinishi.

examples.textEn: Sometimes a disappointing decision is actually the responsible one, and it's worth looking at the bigger picture before criticising anyone.
examples.textUz: Ba’zan ko‘ngilni qoldiradigan qaror aslida mas’uliyatli qaror bo‘ladi. Kimnidir tanqid qilishdan oldin vaziyatning umumiy manzarasiga qarash kerak.

changes.definitionEn: to annoy someone repeatedly
changes.definitionUz: Kimnidir takror-takror bezovta yoki asabiy qilmoq.

examples.textEn: At first, I tried to ignore it, but over time it got on my nerves because quieter students rarely had a chance to contribute.
examples.textUz: Dastlab bunga e’tibor bermaslikka harakat qildim, ammo vaqt o‘tishi bilan asabimga tega boshladi, chunki tortinchoqroq o‘quvchilar fikr bildirishga kamdan-kam imkon topishardi.

changes.definitionEn: to speak briefly to someone, often about a concern
changes.definitionUz: Kimdir bilan, ko‘pincha biror muammo haqida, qisqacha gaplashmoq.

examples.textEn: Rather than confronting him angrily, I decided to have a word with him privately.
examples.textUz: Unga jahl bilan gapirish o‘rniga, o‘zi bilan alohida suhbatlashishga qaror qildim.

changes.definitionEn: to accept and consider feedback or suggestions
changes.definitionUz: Fikr-mulohaza yoki takliflarni qabul qilib, hisobga olmoq.

examples.textEn: To my surprise, he took the feedback on board.
examples.textUz: Ajablanarlisi, u aytilgan fikrni qabul qilib, hisobga oldi.

changes.definitionEn: to surprise someone when they are not prepared
changes.definitionUz: Kimnidir tayyor bo‘lmagan paytida kutilmaganda hayratga solmoq.

examples.textEn: I was caught off guard and initially wanted to refuse, but there didn't seem to be another option.
examples.textUz: Bu men uchun kutilmagan bo‘ldi. Avvaliga rad etmoqchi edim, lekin boshqa iloj yo‘qdek tuyuldi.

records.sourceTranslationUz: biror narsani keragidan ortiq ko‘tarib yubormoq

changes.lemma: make a big deal out of
changes.definitionEn: to treat something as much more important than it is
changes.translationUz: biror narsani keragidan ortiq ko‘tarib yubormoq
changes.definitionUz: Biror narsani aslidan ko‘ra muhimroq deb ko‘rsatmoq.

examples.textEn: What impresses me is that he never makes a big deal out of his generosity.
examples.textUz: Meni hayratlantiradigani, u saxiyligini hech qachon ko‘z-ko‘z qilmaydi.

records.sourceTranslationUz: o‘z targ‘ib qilgan tamoyillaringga amal qilmoq
records.replacedIrrelevantSourceExample: What impresses me is that he never makes a big deal out of his generosity.

changes.definitionEn: to behave according to the standards you recommend to others
changes.translationUz: o‘z targ‘ib qilgan tamoyillaringga amal qilmoq
changes.definitionUz: Boshqalarga tavsiya qiladigan tamoyillarga o‘zi ham amal qilmoq.

examples.textEn: But judging by his actions, he consistently practises what he preaches.
examples.textUz: Ammo uning ishlariga qaraganda, u o‘zi aytgan tamoyillarga muntazam amal qiladi.

changes.definitionEn: to amount to a particular total or sum
changes.definitionUz: Jami bo‘lib muayyan miqdorga yetmoq.

examples.textEn: A decent console, controllers and a few games can add up to a significant amount of money.
examples.textUz: Yaxshi o‘yin konsoli, boshqaruv qurilmalari va bir nechta o‘yin jami bo‘lib ancha pulga tushishi mumkin.

changes.definitionEn: to fail to have the chance to experience something
changes.definitionUz: Biror imkoniyat yoki tajribadan foydalana olmay qolmoq.

examples.textEn: But for now, I don't feel as though I'm missing out.
examples.textUz: Ammo hozircha biror narsadan quruq qolayotgandek his qilmayman.

changes.definitionEn: to stay at the same level or pace as something
changes.definitionUz: Kimdir yoki nimadir bilan bir xil daraja yoxud sur’atda davom etmoq.

examples.textEn: It's taught me that you don't have to keep up with everyone else's purchases to have a good social life.
examples.textUz: Bu menga yaxshi ijtimoiy hayot kechirish uchun boshqalarning barcha xaridlariga ergashish shart emasligini o‘rgatdi.

changes.definitionEn: owned or operated by members of one family
changes.definitionUz: Bir oila a’zolariga tegishli yoki ular boshqaradigan.

examples.textEn: A restaurant that opened fairly recently in my area is a small family-run place serving traditional food with a modern twist.
examples.textUz: Yaqinda biz tomonda ochilgan restoran kichkina oilaviy joy bo‘lib, an’anaviy taomlarni zamonaviy usulda taklif qiladi.

changes.definitionEn: an area of ground in a garden where flowers grow
changes.definitionUz: Bog‘da gullar o‘stiriladigan yer maydoni.

examples.textEn: You might see a whole flower bed filled with red, yellow or pink blooms, and the effect is beautiful without being overwhelming.
examples.textUz: Qizil, sariq yoki pushti gullarga to‘la gulzorni ko‘rishingiz mumkin. U ko‘zni qamashtirib yubormasdan chiroyli ko‘rinadi.

changes.definitionEn: to make something brighter or more cheerful
changes.definitionUz: Biror narsani yorqinroq yoki quvnoqroq qilmoq.

examples.textEn: They would brighten up a small outdoor space and give me a reason to spend more time outside in spring.
examples.textUz: Ular kichik hovliga chiroy qo‘shib, bahorda tashqarida ko‘proq vaqt o‘tkazishimga sabab bo‘lardi.

changes.definitionEn: to become even more unpleasant or difficult
changes.definitionUz: Vaziyatning yanada yoqimsiz yoki qiyin bo‘lib borishi.

examples.textEn: Even when things went from bad to worse, he tried to remain hopeful and protect his son's sense of security.
examples.textUz: Ishlar yomondan battarga ketganida ham u umidini saqlashga va o‘g‘li o‘zini xavfsiz his qilishiga harakat qildi.

records.replacedIrrelevantSourceExample: I also appreciated that the story had moments of warmth and humour, which stopped it from becoming too depressing.

changes.definitionEn: focused primarily on the characters and their development
changes.definitionUz: Asosiy e’tibori qahramonlar va ularning rivojlanishiga qaratilgan.

examples.textEn: But I'd recommend it to anyone who enjoys character-driven stories.
examples.textUz: Ammo men uni qahramonlar xarakteri va ruhiyatiga asoslangan hikoyalarni yoqtiradigan har kimga tavsiya qilgan bo‘lardim.

changes.definitionEn: aggressive pressure used to persuade someone to buy
changes.definitionUz: Xarid qildirish uchun o‘tkaziladigan kuchli savdo bosimi.

changes.definitionEn: neat and stylish clothing that is not very formal
changes.definitionUz: Juda rasmiy bo‘lmagan, ammo ozoda va did bilan tanlangan kiyinish uslubi.

examples.textEn: If I had to describe my style in a few words, I'd call it smart casual.
examples.textUz: Uslubimni bir necha so‘z bilan tasvirlashim kerak bo‘lsa, uni ozoda yarim rasmiy uslub deb atardim.

changes.definitionEn: to combine different items in an effective way
changes.definitionUz: Turli buyumlarni bir-biriga mos qilib birlashtirmoq.

examples.textEn: I also tend to stick to neutral colours because they're easy to mix and match, especially when I'm getting ready in a hurry.
examples.textUz: Bundan tashqari, ko‘proq betaraf ranglarni tanlayman, chunki ularni, ayniqsa shoshilib tayyorlanayotganimda, bir-biriga moslash oson.

records.sourceTranslationUz: narx va variantlarni solishtirib xarid qilmoq

changes.definitionEn: to compare prices or products before buying
changes.translationUz: narx va variantlarni solishtirib xarid qilmoq
changes.definitionUz: Xariddan oldin narx yoki mahsulotlarni solishtirmoq.

changes.definitionEn: to think creatively instead of conventionally
changes.definitionUz: Odatiy usullardan tashqariga chiqib ijodiy fikrlamoq.

examples.textEn: Then I suggested we think outside the box and make a simpler model using plastic bottles, sand, cotton and some spare cardboard.
examples.textUz: Keyin noan’anaviy fikrlab, plastik idishlar, qum, paxta va ortiqcha kartondan soddaroq model tayyorlashni taklif qildim.

changes.definitionEn: the busiest daily time for commuting
changes.definitionUz: Kun davomida odamlar ish yoki o‘qishga qatnaydigan eng serqatnov vaqt.

examples.textEn: Since then, I try to travel outside rush hour whenever possible, or I simply walk if my destination isn't too far away.
examples.textUz: Shundan beri imkon qadar tig‘iz qatnov paytidan tashqari vaqtda yurishga harakat qilaman yoki boradigan joyim juda uzoq bo‘lmasa, piyoda boraman.

changes.definitionEn: to release pent-up feelings or energy
changes.definitionUz: Yig‘ilib qolgan his-tuyg‘u yoki ortiqcha quvvatni chiqarib yubormoq.

examples.textEn: After sitting in a classroom all day, running around outside helped me let off steam.
examples.textUz: Kun bo‘yi sinfxonada o‘tirgandan keyin tashqarida yugurib o‘ynash ortiqcha quvvatimni chiqarishga yordam berardi.

changes.definitionEn: balance between work demands and personal life
changes.definitionUz: Ish talablari va shaxsiy hayot o‘rtasidagi muvozanat.

changes.definitionEn: to give work or a document to an authority
changes.definitionUz: Ish yoki hujjatni mas’ul shaxsga topshirmoq.

examples.textEn: I had several subjects to revise, two assignments to hand in and a number of relatives arriving from other towns.
examples.textUz: Bir nechta fandan takrorlashim, ikkita topshiriqni topshirishim kerak edi. Boshqa shaharlardan bir qancha qarindoshlarimiz ham kelayotgan edi.

changes.definitionEn: to make an idea or subject seem real, interesting or exciting
changes.definitionUz: G‘oya yoki mavzuni jonli, qiziqarli va hayajonli qilib ko‘rsatmoq.

examples.textEn: What I liked was the way the film brought complicated emotions to life without making the story feel like a psychology lesson.
examples.textUz: Filmning murakkab his-tuyg‘ularni jonlantirishi, ayni paytda hikoyani psixologiya darsiga aylantirib yubormagani menga yoqdi.

changes.definitionEn: to spend a very large amount of money
changes.definitionUz: Juda katta miqdorda pul sarflamoq.

examples.textEn: I don't mind paying a little more for something durable, but I'm not prepared to spend a fortune just for a brand name.
examples.textUz: Sifatli va uzoq xizmat qiladigan buyumga biroz ko‘proq pul berishga qarshi emasman, lekin faqat brend nomi uchun juda ko‘p pul sarflashga tayyor emasman.

changes.definitionEn: a sudden good or creative idea
changes.definitionUz: Kutilmaganda paydo bo‘ladigan yaxshi yoki ijodiy fikr.

examples.textEn: Research isn't always a matter of having a flash of inspiration.
examples.textUz: Ilmiy izlanish har doim ham kutilmagan ilhom lahzasiga bog‘liq emas.

changes.definitionEn: flowers on a cherry tree, especially in spring
changes.definitionUz: Gilos daraxtining, ayniqsa bahorda ochiladigan gullari.

examples.textEn: Seeing the cherry blossoms would be a bonus, although I know their timing can be unpredictable.
examples.textUz: Sakura gullarini ko‘rish qo‘shimcha zavq bo‘lardi, lekin qachon gullashini oldindan aniq bilish qiyinligini tushunaman.

changes.definitionEn: distinctive and charming in appearance or atmosphere
changes.definitionUz: Ko‘rinishi yoki muhiti o‘ziga xos va jozibali.

examples.textEn: From the outside, it looks rather ordinary, but inside it's full of character, with wooden shelves and books stacked almost to the ceiling.
examples.textUz: Tashqaridan oddiy ko‘rinadi, ammo ichkarida yog‘och javonlar va deyarli shiftgacha taxlangan kitoblar unga o‘ziga xos joziba beradi.

changes.definitionEn: fitting the wearer's body comfortably and neatly
changes.definitionUz: Kiyuvchining gavdasiga qulay va ozoda mos tushadigan.

examples.textEn: For example, I'd much rather wear a well-fitting cotton shirt than an expensive designer top that's uncomfortable.
examples.textUz: Masalan, noqulay qimmat dizayner kiyimidan ko‘ra o‘zimga mos paxtali ko‘ylakni kiyishni afzal ko‘raman.

changes.definitionEn: to start raining suddenly and very heavily
changes.definitionUz: To‘satdan juda kuchli yomg‘ir yog‘a boshlamoq.

examples.textEn: The forecast had mentioned a few showers, but I certainly wasn't expecting the heavens to open quite so suddenly.
examples.textUz: Ob-havo ma’lumotida biroz yomg‘ir aytilgandi, ammo bunchalik to‘satdan jala quyishini kutmagandim.

changes.definitionEn: to stop moving or making progress completely
changes.definitionUz: Harakat yoki rivojlanishning butunlay to‘xtashi.

examples.textEn: Within minutes, the streets were flooded, my shoes were soaked through and the traffic had almost come to a standstill.
examples.textUz: Bir necha daqiqada ko‘chalarni suv bosdi, oyoq kiyimim shilta ho‘l bo‘ldi, transport harakati esa deyarli to‘xtab qoldi.

changes.definitionEn: completely wet
changes.definitionUz: Butunlay ho‘l bo‘lgan.

examples.textEn: Within minutes, the streets were flooded, my shoes were soaked through and the traffic had almost come to a standstill.
examples.textUz: Bir necha daqiqada ko‘chalarni suv bosdi, oyoq kiyimim shilta ho‘l bo‘ldi, transport harakati esa deyarli to‘xtab qoldi.

changes.definitionEn: having very little physical or mental energy left
changes.definitionUz: Jismoniy yoki ruhiy quvvati juda oz qolgan holda davom etmoq.

examples.textEn: I'd had a hectic week, with several deadlines coming up, and I could tell I was running on empty.
examples.textUz: Haftam juda tig‘iz o‘tgandi, bir nechta ishning muddati yaqinlashayotgandi va kuch-quvvatim tugab borayotganini sezardim.

changes.definitionEn: to suddenly begin laughing
changes.definitionUz: Birdan kula boshlamoq.

examples.textEn: Every time our tower collapsed, she burst into laughter rather than getting frustrated.
examples.textUz: Minoramiz har safar qulaganida u xafa bo‘lish o‘rniga birdan kulib yuborardi.

changes.definitionEn: to fail to be used or to be lost without benefit
changes.definitionUz: Ishlatilmay qolmoq yoki foydasiz yo‘qolmoq.

examples.textEn: We had spent days preparing, and it felt as though all our hard work might go to waste.
examples.textUz: Bir necha kun tayyorgarlik ko‘rgandik, endi esa barcha mehnatimiz zoye ketishi mumkindek tuyuldi.

changes.definitionEn: just before the time at which something must happen
changes.definitionUz: Biror ish yoki voqea bo‘lishi kerak bo‘lgan paytdan sal oldin.

examples.textEn: When the judges arrived, we explained not only how the model worked but also why we had adapted it at the last minute.
examples.textUz: Hakamlar kelgach, model qanday ishlashini ham, nega uni so‘nggi daqiqada o‘zgartirganimizni ham tushuntirdik.

changes.definitionEn: completely full
changes.definitionUz: Sig‘imining oxirigacha to‘lgan.

examples.textEn: The minibus was packed to the brim, and I ended up standing near the door with hardly any room to move.
examples.textUz: Mikroavtobus liq to‘la edi. Eshik yonida deyarli qimirlay olmay tik turib ketdim.

changes.definitionEn: a broad uninterrupted view of an area
changes.definitionUz: Biror joyning keng va to‘siqsiz ko‘rinishi.

examples.textEn: You can also see a panoramic view of the city from the upper levels.
examples.textUz: Yuqori qavatlardan shaharning keng qamrovli manzarasini ham tomosha qilish mumkin.

changes.definitionEn: competition between people without hostility
changes.definitionUz: Odamlar o‘rtasidagi adovatsiz musobaqa yoki bellashuv.

examples.textEn: There was always a bit of friendly rivalry, especially when an older group challenged us.
examples.textUz: Ayniqsa katta yoshli bolalar bizni o‘yinga chorlaganida, doim biroz do‘stona raqobat bo‘lardi.

changes.definitionEn: to pause to breathe normally after effort
changes.definitionUz: Zo‘riqishdan keyin odatdagidek nafas olish uchun to‘xtab turmoq.

examples.textEn: At first, I could barely manage a few lengths without stopping to catch my breath.
examples.textUz: Avvaliga nafasimni rostlash uchun to‘xtamasdan hovuz bo‘ylab bir necha marta borib kelishga ham qiynalardim.

changes.definitionEn: physical exercise involving most major muscle groups
changes.definitionUz: Tananing asosiy mushak guruhlarini ishlatadigan jismoniy mashq.

examples.textEn: Swimming also gives me a full-body workout without putting too much strain on my joints, so it's an activity I can imagine continuing for years.
examples.textUz: Suzish bo‘g‘imlarimga ortiqcha yuk bermasdan butun tanamni chiniqtiradi. Shuning uchun bu mashg‘ulotni ko‘p yillar davom ettira olishimni tasavvur qilaman.

changes.definitionEn: able to think clearly and calmly
changes.definitionUz: Aniq va xotirjam fikrlay oladigan.

examples.textEn: Even when I've had a stressful week, I leave the pool feeling clear-headed and energised.
examples.textUz: Haftam og‘ir o‘tgan bo‘lsa ham, hovuzdan fikrim tiniqlashib, kuchga to‘lib chiqaman.

changes.definitionEn: prepared at home rather than commercially
changes.definitionUz: Tayyor ovqat sotiladigan joyda emas, uyda pishirilgan.

examples.textEn: I'd want the meal to be home-cooked rather than ordered from a restaurant.
examples.textUz: Taomni restorandan buyurtma qilish o‘rniga uyda tayyorlashlarini xohlardim.

changes.definitionEn: an expression of dissatisfaction by a customer
changes.definitionUz: Mijozning xizmat yoki mahsulotdan noroziligini bildirishi.

examples.textEn: I'd like to describe a situation from a part-time job at a café, when I disagreed with my manager about how to handle a customer complaint.
examples.textUz: Kafeda yarim kun ishlaganimda mijoz shikoyatini qanday hal qilish masalasida rahbarim bilan kelisha olmagan vaziyatimni tasvirlamoqchiman.

changes.definitionEn: repayment of the entire original purchase price
changes.definitionUz: Xarid uchun to‘langan pulning to‘liq qaytarilishi.

examples.textEn: I thought we should prepare a fresh meal or offer a full refund.
examples.textUz: Men yangidan taom tayyorlab berishimiz yoki pulini to‘liq qaytarishimiz kerak deb o‘yladim.

changes.definitionEn: personal emotional worth beyond financial cost
changes.definitionUz: Puldagi bahodan tashqari shaxsiy xotiralar va hislar bilan bog‘liq qadr.

examples.textEn: What makes the sweater special is its sentimental value rather than its price tag.
examples.textUz: Sviterning o‘zgacha jihati narxi emas, xotiralar bilan bog‘liq qadri edi.

changes.definitionEn: to develop an intuitive understanding of something
changes.definitionUz: Biror narsani asta-sekin ichdan his qilib tushuna boshlamoq.

examples.textEn: I'd probably start in Tokyo, where I'd explore different neighbourhoods, try local food and get a feel for the pace of everyday life.
examples.textUz: Sayohatni Tokiodan boshlab, turli mahallalarni aylanardim, mahalliy taomlarni tatib ko‘rardim va kundalik hayot sur’atini his qilishga urinardim.

changes.definitionEn: to prepare carefully by researching beforehand
changes.definitionUz: Oldindan izlanib, puxta tayyorgarlik ko‘rmoq.

changes.definitionEn: to take a risk in trying or choosing something
changes.definitionUz: Biror narsani tanlash yoki sinab ko‘rishda tavakkal qilmoq.

examples.textEn: I took a chance on it, and my cousin absolutely loved it.
examples.textUz: Tavakkal qilib uni tanladim va u amakivachchamga juda yoqdi.

changes.definitionEn: to respond or decide quickly in an unexpected situation
changes.definitionUz: Kutilmagan vaziyatda tez fikrlab, javob yoki qaror topmoq.

examples.textEn: Then our team leader suggested that we think on our feet: one person would rebuild the slides, while the rest of us checked the figures and rehearsed the key points.
examples.textUz: Keyin guruh rahbarimiz vaziyatga qarab tez qaror qilishni taklif etdi: bir kishi slaydlarni qaytadan tuzadi, qolganlarimiz esa raqamlarni tekshirib, asosiy fikrlarni mashq qilamiz.

changes.definitionEn: an expression of comfort after a worry has ended
changes.definitionUz: Tashvish tugagach yengillikni bildiradigan chuqur nafas.

examples.textEn: When our lecturer said we'd explained the problem clearly, I breathed a sigh of relief.
examples.textUz: O‘qituvchimiz masalani aniq tushuntirganimizni aytganida, yengil nafas oldim.

changes.definitionEn: to cause harm or suffering over time
changes.definitionUz: Vaqt o‘tishi davomida zarar yoki azob yetkazmoq.

examples.textEn: Trying to do everything perfectly had taken a toll on us, whereas dividing up the work made it manageable.
examples.textUz: Hamma ishni mukammal qilishga urinish bizni holdan toydirgandi, ishni bo‘lib bajarish esa uni uddalashga yordam berdi.

changes.definitionEn: surprising in a way that teaches you something new
changes.definitionUz: Yangi narsani anglatib, odamning tushunchasini o‘zgartiradigan.

examples.textEn: Watching his progress was an eye-opening moment.
examples.textUz: Uning rivojlanishini kuzatish men uchun ko‘p narsani yangicha anglatgan lahza bo‘ldi.

changes.definitionEn: applause given by an audience standing to express appreciation
changes.definitionUz: Kuchli olqishlash uchun tomoshabinlarning o‘rnidan turib qarsak chalishi.

examples.textEn: Then, when the actors returned, they received a standing ovation that seemed to go on forever.
examples.textUz: Keyin aktyorlar qaytib chiqqanida, tomoshabinlar o‘rinlaridan turib ularni juda uzoq olqishlashdi.

changes.definitionEn: a sequence of penalty kicks used to decide a drawn match
changes.definitionUz: Durang tugagan o‘yin g‘olibini aniqlash uchun bajariladigan penaltilar ketma-ketligi.

examples.textEn: The match eventually went to a penalty shoot-out.
examples.textUz: O‘yin oxir-oqibat penaltilar seriyasiga qadar bordi.

changes.definitionEn: exciting or worrying because the outcome is uncertain
changes.definitionUz: Natijasi noma’lumligi sababli juda hayajonli yoki xavotirli.

examples.textEn: It was genuinely nail-biting, particularly when our goalkeeper had to save the final kick to keep us in the competition.
examples.textUz: Ayniqsa musobaqada qolishimiz uchun darvozabonimiz oxirgi zarbani qaytarishi kerak bo‘lganida, juda hayajonli edi.

changes.definitionEn: small raised areas on the skin caused by cold, fear or excitement
changes.definitionUz: Sovuq, qo‘rquv yoki hayajon sabab terida mayda bo‘rtmalar paydo bo‘lishi.

examples.textEn: I actually got goosebumps because the moment felt so spontaneous.
examples.textUz: O‘sha lahza juda tabiiy va kutilmagan tuyulgani uchun etim jimirlab ketdi.

changes.definitionEn: the way someone thinks or feels at a particular time
changes.definitionUz: Odamning muayyan paytdagi fikrlashi yoki his-tuyg‘ulari.

examples.textEn: Having a dedicated workspace helps me get into the right frame of mind.
examples.textUz: Alohida ish joyim borligi kerakli ruhiy holatga kirishimga yordam beradi.

changes.definitionEn: a portable battery for charging electronic devices
changes.definitionUz: Elektron qurilmalarni quvvatlash uchun ishlatiladigan ko‘chma batareya.

examples.textEn: Now I save important addresses offline and carry a small power bank.
examples.textUz: Endi muhim manzillarni internetsiz ham ko‘rinadigan qilib saqlayman va kichik portativ quvvatlagich olib yuraman.

changes.definitionEn: pain or irritation in the throat, especially when swallowing
changes.definitionUz: Ayniqsa yutinganda seziladigan tomoqdagi og‘riq yoki achishish.

changes.definitionEn: a place where unwanted things are left
changes.definitionUz: Keraksiz narsalar tashlab ketiladigan joy.

examples.textEn: It was full of weeds and occasionally used as a dumping ground.
examples.textUz: U yerni begona o‘tlar bosgan, ba’zan esa undan chiqindixona sifatida foydalanishardi.

changes.definitionEn: the ability to attract attention as a live performer
changes.definitionUz: Sahnadagi ijro orqali tomoshabin e’tiborini jalb qilish qobiliyati.

examples.textEn: The actor playing the prince had remarkable stage presence.
examples.textUz: Shahzoda rolini ijro etgan aktyor sahnada juda kuchli taassurot qoldirardi.

changes.definitionEn: to work out your location or understand a new situation
changes.definitionUz: Qayerdaligini aniqlamoq yoki yangi vaziyatni tushunib olmoq.

examples.textEn: Eventually, I took a deep breath and tried to get my bearings.
examples.textUz: Oxiri chuqur nafas olib, qayerdaligimni aniqlashga harakat qildim.

changes.definitionEn: to do something to correct a wrong or show regret
changes.definitionUz: Qilgan xatosini tuzatish yoki afsusini ko‘rsatish uchun biror ish qilmoq.

examples.textEn: It was frustrating, but his willingness to make amends changed the situation.
examples.textUz: Bu asabiylashtirardi, ammo uning xatosini tuzatishga tayyorligi vaziyatni o‘zgartirdi.

changes.definitionEn: to keep feeling angry because of something someone did
changes.definitionUz: Kimdir qilgan ish uchun uzoq vaqt undan gina saqlamoq.

examples.textEn: I didn't want to hold a grudge over an accident, especially when my friend had clearly learned from it.
examples.textUz: Ayniqsa do‘stim bu voqeadan saboq olgani ko‘rinib turganida, tasodifiy xato uchun undan gina saqlashni xohlamadim.

changes.definitionEn: extremely happy
changes.definitionUz: Juda baxtiyor bo‘lmoq.

examples.textEn: I was on cloud nine for the rest of the weekend, and we promised not to leave it so long before meeting again.
examples.textUz: Dam olish kunlarining qolgan qismini juda baxtiyor o‘tkazdim. Yana uchrashguncha bunchalik uzoq kutmaslikka va’da berdik.

changes.definitionEn: so attractive or neat that it seems like a perfect picture
changes.definitionUz: Go‘yo mukammal rasmga o‘xshaydigan darajada chiroyli yoki ozoda.

examples.textEn: It wasn't an entirely picture-perfect scene, though.
examples.textUz: Ammo manzara butunlay rasmdagidek mukammal emasdi.

changes.definitionEn: a board used for displaying notes and reminders
changes.definitionUz: Eslatma va xabarlarni ilib qo‘yish uchun ishlatiladigan taxta.

examples.textEn: Above it, I've put up a pinboard where I keep my weekly goals and reminders.
examples.textUz: Uning tepasiga haftalik maqsadlarim va eslatmalarimni iladigan taxta o‘rnatganman.

changes.definitionEn: tidy and without unnecessary objects
changes.definitionUz: Ortiqcha buyumlarsiz, tartibli.

examples.textEn: I try to keep the work surface clutter-free because piles of loose papers can be surprisingly distracting.
examples.textUz: Stolimni ortiqcha narsalarsiz saqlashga harakat qilaman, chunki uyulib yotgan qog‘ozlar odamni kutilganidan ham ko‘proq chalg‘itishi mumkin.

changes.definitionEn: to change from one activity or approach to another
changes.definitionUz: Bir faoliyat yoki yondashuvdan boshqasiga o‘tmoq.

examples.textEn: It also makes it easier to switch gears between English practice and other subjects without wasting time deciding what to do next.
examples.textUz: Bu keyin nima qilishni tanlab vaqt yo‘qotmasdan ingliz tili mashg‘uloti va boshqa fanlar o‘rtasida almashishni ham osonlashtiradi.

changes.definitionEn: to delay or suspend something temporarily
changes.definitionUz: Biror ishni vaqtincha kechiktirmoq yoki to‘xtatib turmoq.

examples.textEn: The most frustrating part was having to put my plans on hold.
examples.textUz: Eng alam qilgani rejalarimni vaqtincha to‘xtatib turishga majbur bo‘lganim edi.

changes.definitionEn: to be extremely important to someone
changes.definitionUz: Kimdir uchun nihoyatda muhim yoki qadrli bo‘lmoq.

examples.textEn: The thought behind the surprise was what meant the world to me, and that's why I still remember it so clearly.
examples.textUz: Bu kutilmagan sovg‘a ortidagi e’tibor men uchun nihoyatda qadrli edi. Shuning uchun uni hali ham aniq eslayman.

changes.definitionEn: an action or method used to achieve another goal
changes.definitionUz: Boshqa bir maqsadga erishish uchun qo‘llanadigan usul yoki harakat.

examples.textEn: However, I see coding as a means to an end, rather than the final destination.
examples.textUz: Ammo men dasturlashni yakuniy maqsad emas, boshqa maqsadga erishish vositasi deb bilaman.

changes.definitionEn: to plan for long-term success rather than quick gains
changes.definitionUz: Tez foydadan ko‘ra uzoq muddatli muvaffaqiyatni ko‘zlab ish tutmoq.

examples.textEn: Financial independence matters too, but I would rather play the long game and build something valuable than chase a quick success.
examples.textUz: Moliyaviy mustaqillik ham muhim. Ammo tez muvaffaqiyat ortidan quvishdan ko‘ra uzoqni ko‘zlab, foydali narsa yaratishni afzal ko‘raman.

changes.definitionEn: to be exactly what someone wants or needs
changes.definitionUz: Odam xohlagan yoki unga kerak bo‘lgan narsaning aynan o‘zi bo‘lmoq.

examples.textEn: For me, it hits the spot because it tastes clean, doesn't feel heavy and is much more satisfying than a fizzy drink.
examples.textUz: U men uchun ayni muddao: ta’mi yengil, og‘irlik qilmaydi va gazli ichimlikdan ko‘ra ko‘proq qoniqish beradi.

changes.definitionEn: an attempt with a low chance of success
changes.definitionUz: Muvaffaqiyat ehtimoli past bo‘lgan urinish.

examples.textEn: I know that such a prize is a long shot at this stage, and I'm not under the illusion that recognition comes quickly.
examples.textUz: Hozirgi bosqichda bunday mukofotni yutish ehtimoli pastligini bilaman va e’tirof tez keladi degan xayolda emasman.

changes.definitionEn: designed and made for a specific purpose
changes.definitionUz: Muayyan maqsad uchun maxsus loyihalangan va qurilgan.

examples.textEn: Everything seemed purpose-built, from the charging sockets beside the desks to the clearly marked shelves.
examples.textUz: Stollar yonidagi quvvatlash rozetkalaridan tortib aniq belgilangan javonlargacha, hammasi o‘z vazifasi uchun maxsus yaratilgandek edi.

changes.definitionEn: to stop striving after earlier achievements
changes.definitionUz: Oldingi yutuqlari bilan kifoyalanib, yangi harakat qilishni to‘xtatmoq.

examples.textEn: From interviews I've seen, he also comes across as someone who is willing to experiment rather than rest on his laurels.
examples.textUz: Men ko‘rgan suhbatlarida ham u oldingi yutuqlari bilan kifoyalanmay, tajriba qilishga tayyor odamdek ko‘rinadi.

changes.definitionEn: to make people feel less uncomfortable when first meeting
changes.definitionUz: Ilk uchrashuvda odamlarning tortinishini kamaytirmoq.

examples.textEn: That simple question broke the ice.
examples.textUz: Shu oddiy savol tortinishimizni yo‘qotib, suhbat boshlashga yordam berdi.

changes.definitionEn: shared beliefs or interests
changes.definitionUz: Bir-biriga mos keladigan umumiy qarash yoki qiziqishlar.

examples.textEn: At first, I thought our interests would be quite different, but we soon found common ground.
examples.textUz: Dastlab qiziqishlarimiz ancha farq qilsa kerak deb o‘yladim, lekin tez orada umumiy jihatlarimizni topdik.

changes.definitionEn: doing something solely to fulfil a formal requirement
changes.definitionUz: Biror ishni faqat rasmiy talab bajarilganini ko‘rsatish uchun qilish.

examples.textEn: When I was at school, some lessons felt like a box-ticking exercise.
examples.textUz: Maktabda o‘qiganimda ayrim darslar shunchaki rasmiy talabni bajarish uchun o‘tilayotgandek tuyulardi.

changes.definitionEn: an ability useful in different jobs or situations
changes.definitionUz: Turli ishlar yoki vaziyatlarda foydasi tegadigan qobiliyat.

examples.textEn: Those are transferable skills that students can apply well beyond the classroom.
examples.textUz: Bular o‘quvchilar sinfxonadan tashqarida ham qo‘llay oladigan ko‘nikmalardir.

changes.definitionEn: lacking the ability or knowledge to cope with a situation
changes.definitionUz: Vaziyatni uddalash uchun bilim yoki qobiliyati yetishmasligi.

examples.textEn: Initially, I was out of my depth.
examples.textUz: Avvaliga bu ishni qanday uddalashni bilmay qoldim.

changes.definitionEn: to do something badly or ruin it
changes.definitionUz: Biror ishni juda yomon bajarmoq yoki buzib qo‘ymoq.

examples.textEn: In fact, he told me he used to make a complete mess of basic conversations.
examples.textUz: Aslida, u menga bir paytlar oddiy suhbatlarda ham butunlay adashib ketishini aytdi.

changes.definitionEn: to stop being together and move in different directions
changes.definitionUz: Birga bo‘lishni to‘xtatib, turli tomonga ketmoq.

examples.textEn: We talked until his station came into view, and then went our separate ways.
examples.textUz: U tushadigan bekat ko‘ringuncha suhbatlashdik, keyin har birimiz o‘z yo‘limizga ketdik.

changes.definitionEn: coral turning pale due to unhealthy environmental conditions
changes.definitionUz: Noqulay atrof-muhit sharoiti tufayli marjonlarning rangsizlanishi.

examples.textEn: The narrator explained coral bleaching in a way that was accessible without oversimplifying the science.
examples.textUz: Hikoyachi marjonlarning oqarishini ilmiy mazmunini haddan tashqari soddalashtirmasdan tushunarli qilib izohladi.

changes.definitionEn: to realise relationships between separate facts
changes.definitionUz: Alohida faktlar orasidagi bog‘liqlikni anglamoq.

examples.textEn: It helped me connect the dots between human activity, warming oceans and the consequences for marine life.
examples.textUz: Bu inson faoliyati, okeanlarning isishi va dengiz hayoti uchun oqibatlar o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlikni tushunishimga yordam berdi.

changes.definitionEn: nervous or tense
changes.definitionUz: Asabiy yoki tarang holatda.

examples.textEn: I'd been studying consistently, but I still felt a little on edge on the morning of the test.
examples.textUz: Muntazam o‘qigan bo‘lsam ham, imtihon kuni ertalab biroz asabiy edim.

changes.definitionEn: extremely delighted
changes.definitionUz: Nihoyatda xursand.

examples.textEn: I was over the moon, partly about finding the book and partly because he had remembered my request.
examples.textUz: Kitob topilganidan ham, u iltimosimni eslab qolganidan ham nihoyatda xursand bo‘ldim.

changes.definitionEn: to fit very closely and comfortably
changes.definitionUz: Gavdaga juda mos va qulay tushmoq.

examples.textEn: It fitted like a glove, and despite being warm, it didn't feel particularly heavy.
examples.textUz: U menga juda mos tushdi va issiq bo‘lsa-da, unchalik og‘ir tuyulmadi.

changes.definitionEn: to create space or an opportunity for something
changes.definitionUz: Biror narsa uchun joy yoki imkoniyat yaratmoq.

examples.textEn: I'd rather schools make room for digital literacy, such as checking whether online information is reliable, protecting personal data and using spreadsheets to answer everyday questions.
examples.textUz: Maktablarda onlayn axborotning ishonchliligini tekshirish, shaxsiy ma’lumotlarni himoyalash va kundalik masalalarni jadvallar yordamida hal qilish kabi raqamli savodxonlikka o‘rin ajratilishini afzal ko‘rardim.

changes.definitionEn: to forget what you were saying or thinking
changes.definitionUz: Nima deyayotganini yoki o‘ylayotganini esdan chiqarib qo‘ymoq.

examples.textEn: When the examiner asked an unexpected question, I briefly lost my train of thought.
examples.textUz: Imtihon oluvchi kutilmagan savol berganida, bir zum fikrimning davomini yo‘qotib qo‘ydim.

changes.lemma: a step in the right direction
changes.definitionEn: a change that makes progress towards an aim
changes.definitionUz: Maqsadga yaqinlashtiradigan ijobiy o‘zgarish.

examples.textEn: Of course, I couldn't judge how well it would work until people began using it, but it seemed like a step in the right direction.
examples.textUz: Albatta, odamlar foydalanishni boshlamaguncha uning qanchalik yaxshi ishlashini baholay olmasdim, ammo bu to‘g‘ri yo‘nalishdagi qadamdek tuyuldi.

changes.definitionEn: designed to reduce surrounding noise
changes.definitionUz: Atrofdagi shovqinni kamaytirishga mo‘ljallangan.

examples.textEn: One of my most recent purchases was a pair of noise-cancelling headphones.
examples.textUz: Yaqinda olgan buyumlarimdan biri shovqinni kamaytiruvchi quloqchin edi.

changes.lemma: put a name to a face
changes.definitionEn: to remember who someone is after recognising the face
changes.definitionUz: Tanish yuzni ko‘rganda o‘sha odam kimligini eslamoq.

examples.textEn: I turned around and saw a familiar face, although it took me a few seconds to put a name to the face.
examples.textUz: O‘girilib tanish bir yuzni ko‘rdim, lekin uning kimligini eslashimga bir necha soniya ketdi.

changes.definitionEn: access without stairs, especially useful to wheelchair users
changes.definitionUz: Zinapoyalarsiz kirish imkoniyati.

examples.textEn: I particularly liked the fact that the designers had thought about step-free access, so people with wheelchairs or pushchairs could move around easily.
examples.textUz: Loyihachilar zinapoyasiz kirish imkoniyatini hisobga olishgani menga ayniqsa yoqdi. Shu tufayli nogironlik aravachasi yoki bolalar aravachasi bilan ham bemalol yurish mumkin edi.

changes.definitionEn: carefulness about small parts or aspects of a task
changes.definitionUz: Ish yoki vazifaning mayda jihatlariga puxta e’tibor berish.

examples.textEn: Another thing I respect is his attention to detail.
examples.textUz: Unda men qadrlaydigan yana bir jihat mayda tafsilotlarga e’tibor berishidir.
